test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 21 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Laundered**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Laundered** is past tense for word **launder **which means to wash and dry cloths.
 
• *Example *: My wife gave me some freshly **laundered **sheets.
 
• The **meaning **of above sentence is that She washed the clothes and worked as maid , factory worker and did some off jobs to earn her living.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Pondered **is past tense for word **ponder **which means to consider something carefully or for an extended period of time

*Example *: He pondered the question before responding.

 
• The word **Unsoldered **is past tense for word **Unsolder** which means remove the soldering.

*Example *: He unsoldered the blue wire that connected to the switch.

 
• The word **Considered **is past tense for word **Consider **which means to carefully consider something before making a decision

*Example *: Do consider what I said before taking any decision.
